sources.title: Original T5 release README
sources.evidence: The original repository snapshot explicitly lists the released T5-Small checkpoint, its Google Cloud Storage location and a nominal 60 million parameters. It describes the text-to-text encoder-decoder framework and calls 512 a default sequence length. Freshly reopened the original raw release README October 27 and reconfirmed the Small checkpoint and nominal 60M total; it supplies no separately labeled active count.

sources.title: Original T5 release commit metadata
sources.evidence: Author time 2019-10-23T23:34:41Z and committer time 2019-10-23T23:52:05Z date the snapshot that already links the released T5-Small weights. February 2020 publicity and later checkpoint conversions do not establish the first release.

sources.title: Original Google T5-Small checkpoint tensor index
sources.evidence: Decoded the 5,974-byte TensorFlow SSTable index without downloading weight shards. Excluding Adafactor slot variables and global_step leaves 131 unique BF16 model tensors with 60,506,624 learned parameters: encoder 18,881,280, decoder 25,175,808, shared embedding 16,449,536. Retained tensor storage bytes equal twice their shape products; there are no partition slices or quantization metadata. Two self-attention relative-bias tables are present, with no cross-attention relative-bias table.

sources.title: Original T5-Small operative configuration
sources.evidence: Six encoder and six decoder blocks, d_model=512, d_ff=2048, d_kv=64 and eight heads. Uses dense ReLU feed-forward layers, shared encoder/decoder embedding and tied decoder embedding/softmax weights. Absolute positional embeddings are disabled. Input/target lengths and max_length are configured to 512; vocabulary padding divisor is 128. Freshly fetched and read the original operative configuration October 27; dimensions and shared embedding settings agree with the retained count. No weights or tensor census were downloaded or repeated.

sources.title: Exploring the Limits of Transfer Learning with a Unified Text-to-Text Transformer
sources.evidence: Describes the original T5 Small dimensions and nominal 60M count, dense encoder-decoder architecture, scale-only layer normalization, relative-position bias, tied embedding/output weights, and text-to-text inputs/outputs. Original T5 uses span-corruption pretraining mixed with supervised tasks. Length 512 describes training/fine-tuning. No dedicated thinking mode, native tool-call interface or separately defined inference active-parameter count is specified. October 27 re-audit reread the full original report from the fresh primary cache, including the Small size definition and encoder/decoder compute discussion; these establish total size but no Small active-count convention.

sources.title: Pinned original T5-Small Transformers configuration
sources.evidence: Confirms six blocks per stack, d_model=512, d_ff=2048, d_kv=64, eight heads, vocabulary 32128 and 32 relative-attention buckets. n_positions=512 is configuration metadata, not a learned absolute-position table or a verified universal serving maximum. Freshly reopened this pinned configuration October 27; all relevant dimensions remain as described.

sources.title: Pinned T5-Small converted safetensors header
sources.evidence: Read only HTTP 206 byte ranges 0-7 and 8-15535, not the weight payload. Header contains 132 F32 tensors totaling 60,506,880 stored elements. A 256-element decoder cross-attention relative-bias tensor is absent from Google's original checkpoint and ignored by the model implementation. Excluding this unused conversion artifact gives the independently verified original total of 60,506,624.

sources.title: T5 model implementation
sources.evidence: Defines dense attention and two-matrix ReLU feed-forward layers, scale-only layer normalization, and tied encoder/decoder/output embeddings. Cross-attention has no relative bias, and T5ForConditionalGeneration explicitly ignores the old converted decoder cross-attention relative-bias key on load. Only the first self-attention block of each stack owns a relative-bias table. Shape-based counting agrees with the original Google index.

sources.title: T5 Small model card
sources.evidence: Heading is T5 Small. Identifies the original Google Research authors, Apache 2.0 license, text-to-text tasks, and C4 span-corruption plus supervised multitask pretraining. This card is authored by Hugging Face; original Google checkpoint metadata independently supplies the exact parameter count. Freshly fetched the full pinned card October 27; it explicitly calls this the 60-million-parameter checkpoint and gives no separate active count.

sources.title: Original T5 Apache License 2.0
sources.evidence: Original released project carries Apache License 2.0, consistent with the exact checkpoint model card.

sources.title: T5X released-model documentation
sources.evidence: Later first-party documentation links the original T5 Small checkpoint at step 1000000 and distinguishes original T5 from T5 1.1, LM-adapted and Flan variants. Original T5 uses supervised multitask pretraining and shared embeddings; later variant dimensions and counts are not transferred. It does not give a separate inference active-parameter count for original T5 Small. Freshly reopened the full current T5X documentation October 27. Its original Small row remains distinct from T5 1.1 and Flan rows; GEGLU and unshared classifier changes preclude substituting later-variant counts.

sources.title: Language Models are Few-Shot Learners, Appendix D
sources.evidence: Table D.1 includes the exact T5-Small model with nominal 60M parameters and an active fraction of 0.5 for a simplified training-FLOP estimate. Appendix D explicitly omits attention-operation costs. This comparison is not an original-developer disclosure of a per-token inference active-parameter count and does not establish a 30M active catalog value. Rechecked the original Appendix D comparison on October 27. The Small row and its 0.5 fraction are expressly part of approximate training-FLOP calculations, not a separate inference specification.

sources.title: Mixture of Experts Architecture for Machine Translation on Edge Devices
sources.evidence: Freshly read the complete February 2025 post. It reports original Tibetan translation experiments and an introductory resource table claiming 60M active parameters per token for T5-Small. The table provides no measurement method or source and follows a dense-equals-all assertion; its approximate 4B FLOPs per token is also unexplained. The measured BLEU/chrF/TER results do not establish the assumed resource counts. Do not treat this table as a supported developer or model-research active-parameter specification.

sources.title: MoEfication: Transformer Feed-forward Layers are Mixtures of Experts
sources.publisher: Zhang et al. / Tsinghua University and Tencent
sources.evidence: Freshly downloaded and read the original 14-page ACL paper October 27. It explicitly uses original 60M T5-Small, distinguishes its distilled version, and studies positive-ReLU neuron fractions and routed subsets of FFN parameters. These are data-dependent activation statistics and changes to execution, not a published whole-model nominal active count for the original unmodified Small checkpoint. No count is obtained by multiplying its fractions by the total.

sources.title: Entities: what are they, where are they and how do we model them?
sources.evidence: Freshly inspected the original TAC keynote comparison, slide 74. Its explicit All/Activated parameter columns contain T5 3B, T5 11B and T5 11B with salient-span masking, but no T5-Small row. This useful original nominal convention for other exact variants does not independently supply a Small value.

name.note: Original T5 Small, not T5 1.1 Small or Flan-T5 Small. Normalize capitalization to the exact checkpoint card heading.

developer.note: Google Research developed the original model; the report lists individual authors.

release_date.note: The dated original repository snapshot explicitly links the released Small checkpoint. Retain this date rather than later publicity or conversion dates.

open_weights.note: Original Google weights are publicly linked; original tensor index and converted checkpoint header were accessible.

license.note: Exact checkpoint license metadata agrees with the original project license.

parameters_b.note: Exact complete learned count, 60,506,624 parameters divided by 1e9, not the rounded 60M label. Sum 131 unique BF16 Google model tensors; exclude optimizer slots and global_step. Encoder 18,881,280 + decoder 25,175,808 + shared embedding 16,449,536. Shared encoder/decoder/output embedding counted once. With D=512, I=8*64=512, F=2048, Le=Ld=6, V=32128, B=32, H=8, independent formula V*D + Le*(4*D*I+2*D*F+2*D) + Ld*(8*D*I+2*D*F+3*D) + 2*D + 2*B*H agrees. HF storage includes an extra unused 256-element cross-attention bias, excluded from the original model count. October 27 re-audit retains this supported total and freshly reconfirms Google’s nominal 60M specification and exact original variant through the release README, operative configuration, pinned card/config and current T5X documentation. No fresh tensor census was required.

active_parameters_b.note: October 27 fresh exact Small total/active/activated and later original-comparison searches found no supported separate active-count convention. Reopened the original release, operative configuration, pinned card/config, full original report and current T5X model documentation. GPT-3 Appendix D is approximate training-FLOP accounting, while MoEfication measures input-dependent FFN neuron fractions and altered execution. Google Research’s TAC active-count table has 3B/11B rows only. OpenPecha’s 60M per-token resource estimate is unsourced and justified by dense architecture; its original translation scores do not validate that estimate. No documented sized unchanged base fills the gap, and structurally changed T5 1.1/Flan variants cannot substitute. Keep null rather than equating active with total or a computed decoder subtotal.

architecture.note: Six-block bidirectional encoder and six-block causal decoder with cross-attention; dense ReLU feed-forward layers, relative self-attention bias and scale-only normalization. No mixture-of-experts routing.

context_window.note: The catalog field denotes maximum context. Sources establish 512 training/default input and target lengths, not a universal maximum for this relative-position encoder-decoder checkpoint. Configured max_length and n_positions metadata do not independently verify a universal serving or architectural cap. Relative-bias distance buckets are not a context limit; do not infer unlimited supported context either.

modalities.note: Original text-to-text checkpoint consumes and generates tokenized text.

reasoning.note: No dedicated thinking mode or explicitly trained reasoning capability is established for this exact original checkpoint. Ordinary supervised NLP tasks and later Flan variants are insufficient evidence.

tool_call.note: No native tool/function-call interface or training is documented for this original checkpoint; arbitrary text generation does not establish it.

description.value: Original T5 encoder-decoder model pretrained with span corruption and supervised text-to-text tasks.
description.note: Describes original multitask T5 without transferring T5 1.1 or Flan training or capabilities.

patch.name: T5 Small
patch.description: Original T5 encoder-decoder model pretrained with span corruption and supervised text-to-text tasks.
patch.notes: Google reports a nominal 60M total; the original checkpoint contains 60,506,624 unique learned parameters, counting shared encoder/decoder/output embeddings once. An unused 256-element bias in a converted checkpoint is excluded. No separate active-parameter count was found in the checked primary sources. Length 512 is a training/default sequence length, not an established maximum. Original public release: October 23, 2019.

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit retains the verified 60,506,624 total and freshly reconfirms the nominal 60M original Small specification. Separate active count remains undisclosed after exact-model and later original-comparison searches; training-FLOP fractions, FFN activation statistics, unsupported forum resource estimates and other T5 variants are not substituted. Explicitly patch active_parameters_b to null. All twelve nonparameter assessments and previous corrections are preserved; no weights or repeated tensor census.
